<plan>Plan to achieve all achievements:
1. Collect the stone in front (Collect Stone, Achievement 10).
2. Move north onto the grass tile (Move North).
3. Place a table to the front (Place Table, Achievement 2).
4. Navigate to the tree 7 steps north‑east to collect wood
   – use successive Move East/Move North until reaching the tree,
     then Do (Collect Wood, Achievement 1).
5. Craft a wood pickaxe and wood sword using the table
   – Make Wood Pickaxe (Achievement 6) and Make Wood Sword (Achievement 7).
6. Collect iron 3 steps west (Move West × 3, then Do),
   then craft a stone pickaxe (Make Stone Pickaxe, Achievement 14)
   and a stone sword (Make Stone Sword, Achievement 15).
7. Collect coal 2 steps south‑west (Move South × 2 → Move West × 2, then Do)
   and craft an iron pickaxe (Make Iron Pickaxe, Achievement 20)
   and an iron sword (Make Iron Sword, Achievement 21).
8. Reach the cow 6 steps north‑west, Do to eat it (Eat Cow, Achievement 3).
9. Defeat the skeleton at 3 steps north (Do after relocating to that spot,
   Achievement 13). The zombie can be defeated when it appears.
10. Place a furnace on a stone tile (Place Furnace, Achievement 17)
    and collect diamond 7 steps east‑north (Move East × 7 → Move North × 7, then Do).
11. Place a plant in front of us (Place Plant, Achievement 8) and eat it
    (Eat Plant).
12. Collect a drink by doing a Do action near a lake (Collect Drink, Achievement 5).
13. Sleep when energy is below maximum to restore energy and wake up 
    (Sleep → Wake Up, Achievement 16).
All achievements can be obtained in this order.
